note: Benchmaxxing calibration tier table (job bh-benchmaxxing-calibration-20260917). Keyed by benchmark family (registry id before '::'). Tiers: headline = public question set that labs quote in release posts, so it is the board most exposed to targeted tuning and contamination; heldout = private/unpublished questions, tasks created after most training cutoffs, or a held-out split, which a lab cannot tune toward; domain = a vertical professional domain (legal, finance, spreadsheet, medical) whose gaps mostly show specialisation; secondary = public but rarely quoted, or measures a trait rather than task skill; aggregate = an index built from other boards (never compared); judged = graded by votes or a judge model (already outside the signal). Only benchmark facts decide a tier, never who scores well on it.

aa-aime.reason: AIME 2025 problems are public and quoted in nearly every reasoning-model release post.

aa-gpqa-diamond.reason: Public 198-question set, the most-quoted science number in release posts.

openrouter-gpqa-diamond.reason: Same public GPQA Diamond questions, re-run by OpenRouter.

aa-hle.reason: Humanity's Last Exam questions are public and a standard release-post headline.

aa-scicode.reason: Public SciCode problems, long part of the widely quoted AA index.

aa-ifbench.reason: Public IFBench prompts and checkers, quoted in open-model cards.

aa-tau2-telecom.reason: tau2-bench is public and one of the most-quoted agent numbers in release posts.

openrouter-tau2-bench-airline.reason: Public tau2-bench airline domain, re-run by OpenRouter.

aa-terminal-bench.reason: Terminal-Bench 2.x tasks are public and quoted in nearly every coding/agent release post.

vals-index-terminal-bench-2.1.reason: Same public Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks, run by Vals.

aa-terminal-bench-hard.reason: Pinned subset of the public Terminal-Bench tasks.

aa-mmmu-pro.reason: Public MMMU-Pro questions, the standard vision headline.

aa-lcr.reason: AA-LCR dataset is published and quoted in open-model cards.

simpleqa-verified.reason: Public SimpleQA Verified questions, quoted in release posts.

aa-omniscience.reason: Private AA question set; also penalises confident wrong answers, which tuning on public sets does not help.

aa-critpt.reason: Research-level physics with answers kept private by the authors.

aa-tau3-banking.reason: New tau3 banking domain, not yet a release-post number.

aa-automationbench.reason: AA runs a held-out split of AutomationBench.

aa-enterpriseops-gym.reason: New enterprise MCP environments, not a release-post number.

aa-itbench.reason: AA's offline incident snapshots, not quoted by labs.

aa-terminal-bench@4.0.reason: Terminal-Bench v4.0 is a fresh task set released after most current models were trained; applies to version 4.0 only.

deepswe.reason: Original long-horizon tasks written by Datacurve, not public repos' history.

frontiermath-tiers-1-3.reason: Unpublished problems, run only by Epoch AI.

frontiermath-tier-4.reason: Unpublished research-level problems, run only by Epoch AI.

matharena-arxivmath.reason: Problems from June 2026 arXiv papers, newer than training data.

vals-index-code-migration.reason: Vals private task set (general coding, not a vertical domain).

vals-index-finance-agent.reason: Vertical finance work; a gap shows specialisation.

gso.reason: Public repos, rarely quoted; tiny cohort (10).

bullshitbench-v1.reason: Measures a trait (premise pushback), not task skill.

bullshitbench-v2.reason: Measures a trait (premise pushback), not task skill.

aa_coding_index.reason: Average of AA coding component boards.

vals-index.reason: GDP-weighted average of its Vals component boards.

aa-apex-agents.reason: Graded deliverables (judge); already outside the signal.

aa_agentic_index.reason: Average of Artificial Analysis' agentic evaluations (one measured configuration per model), relayed by OpenRouter's Benchmarks API.
